admission.title: Steps to Join Universitas Mataram
admission.subtitle: A step-by-step roadmap for prospective international students embarking on their academic journey in Lombok.

steps.title: Explore Study Programs
steps.desc: Browse undergraduate, postgraduate, or Indonesian language and culture immersion offerings at UNRAM.

steps.title: Prepare Requirements
steps.desc: Gather academic transcripts, English/Indonesian proficiency tests, a valid passport (min. 24 months), and letters of recommendation.

steps.title: Submit Online Dossier
steps.desc: Complete the official IAO UNRAM online registration form and upload certified digital copies of all required documents.

steps.title: Study Permit & Arrival
steps.desc: Upon receipt of your Letter of Acceptance (LoA), our team coordinates your Ministry Study Permit and electronic visa (KITAS).

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: Direct answers to key inquiries regarding international admission, visa regulations, and student life in Lombok.

items.q: Does Universitas Mataram offer scholarships for international students?
items.a: TODO: replace (Yes, international students may apply through the Indonesian Government's Developing Countries Partnership (KNB) Scholarship, bilateral governmental grants, or selective UNRAM tuition waiver programs based on academic excellence).

items.q: What is the procedure for obtaining a student visa and stay permit?
items.a: TODO: replace (Once admitted, IAO UNRAM assists in obtaining the mandatory Study Permit from the Ministry of Higher Education. We then guide you through the electronic limited-stay visa (e-ITAS) process prior to landing at Lombok International Airport).

items.q: Is on-campus or student accommodation provided near the university?
items.a: TODO: replace (UNRAM provides campus dormitories (Rusunawa), and our office helps international students find verified, budget-friendly off-campus private rooms and homestays within safe walking distance).

items.q: How can UNRAM domestic students apply for outbound exchange programs like IISMA?
items.a: TODO: replace (Enrolled UNRAM students can access eligibility guidelines on our portal, participate in preparation workshops, and request official institutional nomination letters from IAO UNRAM ahead of national deadlines).

items.q: What is the primary language of instruction for international students?
items.a: TODO: replace (Select degree programs offer English-taught courses. For regular Indonesian-language tracks, UNRAM delivers intensive Indonesian Language for Foreign Speakers (BIPA) preparatory classes).

items.q: How can an overseas university or research body initiate an MoU with UNRAM?
items.a: TODO: replace (Prospective institutions can submit a formal letter of intent and draft agreement via our contact form or directly to io@unram.ac.id for review by our Rectorate and Legal Partnerships bureau).
